description: This file contains an abstract class 'Smarty_Resource' which serves as a base for different resource plugins in the Smarty templating system. It defines methods for loading resources, parsing resource names, initializing source objects, and managing resource metadata. The class includes static methods for loading resource handlers based on resource type, and abstract methods that subclasses must implement for content loading and metadata population.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource
classes.description: An abstract base class for resource plugins in the Smarty template engine, providing methods for resource handling, parsing, and metadata management.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and returns a resource handler object based on the resource type, searching cache, registered resources, sysplugins, plugins, or streams.

methods.name: parseResourceName
methods.description: Parses a resource name string to extract the type and name components.

methods.name: getUniqueTemplateName
methods.description: Generates a unique resource name for a template, resolving relative paths if needed.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Initializes or loads a Smarty_Template_Source object for a given resource.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Abstract method to load the content of the resource; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Abstract method to populate the source object with metadata; to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Populates timestamp and existence info for the source object; default implementation is blank.

methods.name: buildUniqueResourceName
methods.description: Builds a unique identifier for the resource, based on directory paths and resource name.

methods.name: getBasename
methods.description: Returns a sanitized base filename for a resource.

methods.name: checkTimestamps
methods.description: Indicates whether timestamp checks should be performed for this resource.
